page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7nex.32xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, driven by Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 512.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be fulfilled via network-attached volumes.

For network-intensive operations, the instance provides a high baseline network bandwidth of 160 Gbps. This high-throughput network interface supports massive data transfers and efficient communication in clustered environments. From a resource density perspective, the combination of 128 dedicated cores and 512.0 GB of RAM offers a highly consolidated platform for enterprise workloads, balancing compute capacity and memory allocation without the overhead of local storage maintenance.

The ecs.g7nex.32xlarge is designed for large-scale enterprise applications, high-traffic web serving, distributed caching, and application servers. It is also suitable for database hosting and backend processing systems that rely on network-attached storage and require substantial parallel processing capabilities.
